companies.name: ヤム・チャイナ・ホールディングス
companies.sub: 中国の最大フランチャイジー

relations.text: 中国本土で最大のマスターフランチャイジーであり、系列店売上高の3%を継続的な手数料として支払う
relations.text_en: Yum China is the largest master franchisee and pays a continuing fee of 3% on system sales in mainland China

source.label: Yum! Brands 10-K(2025年12月31日期)
source.quote: As our largest master franchisee, Yum China, pays the Company a continuing fee of 3% on system sales of our Concepts in mainland China.

companies.name: マクレーン・フードサービス

relations.text: 米国でKFC、タコベル、ピザハットの最大の流通業者を務める
relations.text_en: McLane serves as the largest distributor for KFC, Taco Bell and Pizza Hut in the U.S.

source.label: Yum! Brands 10-K(2025年12月31日期)
source.quote: RSCS manages our relationship with McLane Foodservice, Inc. (“McLane”) which serves as the largest distributor for the Company’s KFC, Taco Bell and Pizza Hut Concepts in the U.S.

companies.name: レストラン・サプライチェーン・ソリューションズ

relations.text: 米国で一部の店舗用食材と設備の購買を担う第三者組織で、同社と各フランチャイズ団体が構成員である
relations.text_en: RSCS is a third party that purchases certain restaurant products and equipment, and the Company and its franchisee groups are members

source.label: Yum! Brands 10-K(2025年12月31日期)
source.quote: In the U.S., the Company, along with the representatives of the Company’s KFC, Taco Bell and Pizza Hut franchisee groups, are members of Restaurant Supply Chain Solutions, LLC (“RSCS”), a third party which is responsible for purchasing certain restaurant products and equipment.

companies.name: デヴヤニ・インターナショナル

relations.text: インドでKFCとピザハットを運営する加盟企業で、同社は保有していた約5%の少数株を2024年第1四半期に売却した
relations.text_en: Devyani is a franchise entity operating KFC and Pizza Hut in India, in which the Company sold its approximate 5% minority investment

source.label: Yum! Brands 10-K(2025年12月31日期)
source.quote: Investment in Devyani During the quarter ended March 31, 2024, we sold our approximate 5% minority investment in Devyani International Limited (“Devyani”), a franchise entity that operates KFC and Pizza Hut restaurants in India, for pre-tax proceeds of $ 104 million.

note.ja: 公式資料で確認できた関係だけを載せています。投資判断を勧めるものではありません。
note.en: Only relationships confirmed in official materials are shown. Not investment advice.
